about: Common words for kinds of work and the guides that hold them (agentlink/guideidx.py). The connect text gives one line per entry, made from the guides there at the time; guide_read with an unknown topic matches the words and answers the guides. An add-on can put a guide_words.json of the same shape in the guide folder it registers.
